HYPOTHESIS (final candidate): In ML-enabled systems, the two roles with the highest proportion of association with requirements are the Project Lead and the Data Scientist. In the supplied survey (276 respondents; 194 answered the Q8 role items; the 82 suspended surveys, NA-coded -77 in all Q8 items, were excluded from the denominator), the Project Lead was cited as addressing ML-related requirements by 51.031% of respondents (bootstrap 95% CI [44.330, 58.247]) and the Data Scientist by 48.969% (95% CI [41.753, 56.186]), clearly ahead of every other role (Business Analyst 25.773%, Developer 19.072%, Solution Architect 12.371%, Requirement Engineer 10.309%, Others 9.794%, Tester 1.031%). In the secondary project-weighted variant (weight = number of ML projects per respondent, total weight 1344), the Data Scientist leads at 61.384% (95% CI [44.095, 76.955]) with the Project Lead second at 46.280% (95% CI [31.613, 63.287]). All point estimates and CIs were computed from the supplied file via respondent-level bootstrap (B=10,000, with replacement, seed 42, percentile 2.5/97.5). The quoted CIs in the question ([49.219, 49.981] and [60.955, 61.822]) are far narrower than resampling this file can produce and appear to come from the study's own pipeline; so do the exact quoted figures 49.6% and 61.389% (the weighted Data-Scientist estimate 61.384% matches the latter near-exactly). The role identification — Project Lead and Data Scientist as the top two — is what the data supports, and the top-two ranking is robust across every denominator and weighting variant tested.

WORKFLOW: (1) Coding rule: Q8_ML_Addressing_<role> 'quoted' → 1 (associated), 'not quoted' → 0, '-77' → NA. Note the dataset uses -77 (not -99) as the sentinel for these Q8 items; sentinel negatives are treated as NA and excluded, consistent with the 82 'Suspended (22)' surveys that never answered Q8. (2) Primary analysis: respondent-level proportion per role, denominator = 194 valid respondents. (3) Secondary analysis: project-weighted proportion using D7_Total_ML_Projects as weight (its 26 × -99 values excluded; 16 of the 194 respondents dropped from this variant only). (4) Bootstrap: B = 10,000 resamples with replacement at the respondent level, 95% CI as 2.5th/97.5th percentiles, fixed RNG seed 42. (5) Ranking of all 8 roles by proportion; top two reported.
